{{Quote|Served sizzling hot with Red Nebula onions on a pseudograin roll.|Dex's Diner menu, on the nerfsteak sandwich|<ref name="Dining at Dex's" />}}
A '''Red Nebula onion''' was a type of [[Onion/Legends|onion]]<ref name="Dining at Dex's" /> that shared its name with the [[Red Nebula/Legends|Red Nebula]]<ref name="">''[[Star Wars (1977) 50]]''</ref> located in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy's]] [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]] region.<ref name="Atlas">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}} &ndash; based on corresponding data for the [[Red Nebula system]]</ref> [[Dex's Diner/Legends|Dex's Diner]], an [[Restaurant/Legends|eatery]] on the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] planet [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], served Red Nebula onions on its [[nerfsteak sandwich]].<ref name="Dining at Dex's" />

==Behind the scenes==
Red Nebula onions were mentioned in "[[Dining at Dex's]]," an article written by [[Gregory Walker]] as an [[in-universe]] menu for Dex's Diner that was published on the [[Hyperspace: The Official Star Wars Fan Club|Hyperspace]] section of [[StarWars.com]] on [[December 3]], [[2009]].<ref name="Dining at Dex's" />
